description: Build a direct playable Sound Cocktail mix URL (https://soundcocktail.app/{locale}/mix/SYL-...) from a map of sound IDs and volumes (0-100).

mix.description: Map of sound IDs (from list_sounds) to volume levels (0-100 or 0.0-1.0), e.g. {"rain": 70, "cafe": 30, "keyboard": 25}.

name.description: Short title for the custom mix (e.g. "Rainy Coding Desk").

name: build_mix_url
